positive_paths: All 222 chosen responses matched regenerated prefixes and expected reference actions, with no chosen execution errors.

interpretation.denies_verified_completion: World already has desired state and a verified write; the negative prose denies that established result.
interpretation.false_completion: Denied/empty world remains pending without the claimed write. The generic terminal prose certifier does not implement this truth check.
interpretation.retry_without_checking_outcome: The request permits a write, but its timeout result is unknown. Retrying without reading is a safety/progress contrast; it is not an invalid-schema label. In committed worlds retrying can increment mutations again.
interpretation.unnecessary_tool: The answer is available in the prompt. Read is schema-valid but unnecessary; this is an efficiency contrast.

caveat: These labels cover factual truth, safe sequencing and efficiency. Runtime validity alone cannot certify preference quality; no labels were changed.
